import { Roles } from "@/types/globals";

export default function UsersPage() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUser[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState(0);
  const [hasNextPage, setHasNextPage] = useState(false);
  const [hasPreviousPage, setHasPreviousPage] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<any>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error', text: string } | null>(null);

  const pageSize = 10;

  const loadUsers = async (page: number = 1) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const result = await getUsers(page, pageSize);
      setUsers(result.users);
      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
      setHasNextPage(result.hasNextPage);
      setHasPreviousPage(result.hasPreviousPage);
      setCurrentPage(page);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to load users' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    try {
      const stats = await getUserStatistics();
      setStatistics(stats);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load statistics:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      loadUsers(1);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const result = await searchUsers(searchQuery, pageSize);
      setUsers(result.users);
      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
      setHasNextPage(false);
      setHasPreviousPage(false);
      setCurrentPage(1);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to search users' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, newRole: Roles) => {
    try {
      const result = await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Update the user in the local state
        setUsers(users.map(user =>
          user.id === userId ? { ...user, role: newRole } : user
        ));
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user role' });
    }
  };

  const handleBanToggle = async (userId: string, currentBanned: boolean) => {
    try {
      const result = await toggleUserBan(userId, !currentBanned);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Update the user in the local state
        setUsers(users.map(user =>
          user.id === userId ? { ...user, banned: !currentBanned } : user
        ));
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user status' });
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (userId: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await deleteUser(userId);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Remove the user from local state
        setUsers(users.filter(user => user.id !== userId));
        setTotalCount(totalCount - 1);
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to delete user' });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUsers();
    loadStatistics();
  }, []);

  // Auto-hide messages after 5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (message) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage(null), 5000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message]);

  const formatDate = (timestamp: number) => {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const getRoleBadgeVariant = (role: Roles | null) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'admin': return 'destructive';
      case 'user': return 'secondary';
      default: return 'outline';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">User Management</h1>
      </div>

      {/* Statistics Cards */}
      {statistics && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Total Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.totalUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Active This Week</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.activeThisWeek}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">New This Month</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.newThisMonth}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Admin Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.adminUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Banned Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.bannedUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Message Alert */}
      {message && (
        <Alert variant={message.type === 'error' ? 'destructive' : 'default'}>
          <AlertDescription>{message.text}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Search and Controls */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Search Users</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <Input
              placeholder="Search by email or name..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
            />
            <Button onClick={handleSearch}>Search</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
              setSearchQuery('');
              loadUsers(1);
            }}>
              Clear
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Users Table */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Users ({totalCount})</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8">Loading users...</div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>User</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Last Sign In</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {users.map((user) => (
                    <TableRow key={user.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <img
                            src={user.imageUrl}
                            alt={`${user.firstName || ''} ${user.lastName || ''}`}
                            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
                          />
                          <span>{user.firstName} {user.lastName}</span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{user.email}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Select
                          value={user.role || 'user'}
                          onValueChange={(value) => handleRoleChange(user.id, value as Roles)}
                        >
                          <SelectTrigger className="w-24">
                            <SelectValue />
                          </SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="user">User</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem>
                          </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant={user.banned ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'}>
                          {user.banned ? 'Banned' : 'Active'}
                        </Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{formatDate(user.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {user.lastSignInAt ? formatDate(user.lastSignInAt) : 'Never'}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant={user.banned ? "outline" : "destructive"}
                            onClick={() => handleBanToggle(user.id, user.banned)}
                          >
                            {user.banned ? 'Unban' : 'Ban'}
                          </Button>
                          <Dialog>
                            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
                            </DialogTrigger>
                            <DialogContent>
                              <DialogHeader>
                                <DialogTitle>Delete User</DialogTitle>
                                <DialogDescription>
                                  Are you sure you want to delete {user.firstName} {user.lastName}? This action cannot be undone.
                                </DialogDescription>
                              </DialogHeader>
                              <DialogFooter>
                                <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
                                <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => handleDelete(user.id)}>
                                  Delete
                                </Button>
                              </DialogFooter>
                            </DialogContent>
                          </Dialog>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>

              {/* Pagination */}
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mt-4">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Showing {users.length} of {totalCount} users
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => loadUsers(currentPage - 1)}
                    disabled={!hasPreviousPage}
                  >
                    Previous
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => loadUsers(currentPage + 1)}
                    disabled={!hasNextPage}
                  >
                    Next
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

"use client";

import { UserButton } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Card } from "@buzztrip/components";
import { Badge } from "@buzztrip/components/ui";

export function AdminLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const navigation = [
    { name: "Dashboard", href: "/", current: pathname === "/" },
    { name: "Users", href: "/users", current: pathname === "/users" },
    { name: "Maps", href: "/maps", current: pathname === "/maps" },
    { name: "Analytics", href: "/analytics", current: pathname === "/analytics" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Navigation Header */}
      <header className="bg-white shadow-sm border-b">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-8">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">BuzzTrip Admin</h1>
                <Badge variant="secondary">Beta</Badge>
              </div>
              <nav className="flex space-x-6">
                {navigation.map((item) => (
                  <Link
                    key={item.name}
                    href={item.href}
                    className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${
                      item.current
                        ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"
                        : "text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.name}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </nav>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              <UserButton
                appearance={{
                  elements: {
                    avatarBox: "w-8 h-8"
                  }
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <main className="container mx-auto p-6">
        {children}
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t mt-12">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-4">
          <div className="text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            BuzzTrip Admin Portal - {new Date().getFullYear()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

## Phase 2 Complete: Authentication & Security Infrastructure ✅

I have successfully completed Phase 2 of the BuzzTrip Admin Portal development! Here's a comprehensive summary of what was implemented:

### ✅ **Admin Role Verification System**
- **Metadata-based Authentication**: Implemented proper Clerk role verification using `publicMetadata.role`
- **TypeScript Types**: Created global type definitions for `Roles` and `CustomJwtSessionClaims`
- **Helper Functions**: Built reusable utility functions (`checkRole`, `isAdmin`, `requireAdmin`, `isAdminUser`)
- **Fallback Authentication**: Email-based admin check for initial setup before roles are configured

### ✅ **Robust Middleware & Security**
- **Enhanced Middleware**: Updated `/middleware.ts` with proper role-based protection
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive try-catch blocks with proper error logging
- **Security Logging**: Admin access attempts are logged for security monitoring
- **Redirect Handling**: Proper redirect URLs for better UX during authentication
- **Unauthorized Page**: Created dedicated `/unauthorized` page for non-admin users

### ✅ **Admin-Specific Convex Queries**
- **Analytics Queries**: Comprehensive admin queries in `/packages/backend/convex/admin.ts`:
  - `getUserStats()` - User growth, registration trends, activity metrics
  - `getMapStats()` - Maps, collaboration patterns, content metrics
  - `getActivityMetrics()` - User engagement, feature adoption, session data
  - `getGlobalStats()` - Places, reviews, photos aggregation
  - `getDashboardOverview()` - Combined metrics for dashboard view

### ✅ **User Management with Clerk Admin SDK**
- **Server Actions**: Complete user management system in `/app/actions/user-management.ts`:
  - `getUsers()` - Paginated user listing with search
  - `updateUserRole()` - Role assignment functionality
  - `toggleUserBan()` - Ban/unban user capabilities
  - `deleteUser()` - User deletion with proper security
  - `searchUsers()` - Search by email and name

```typescript
import posthog from 'posthog-js';

// PostHog configuration
const POSTHOG_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY;
const POSTHOG_HOST = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST || 'https://us.i.posthog.com';

// Check if PostHog should be enabled
const isPostHogEnabled = !!(POSTHOG_KEY && typeof window !== 'undefined');

// Initialize PostHog only if keys are provided
if (isPostHogEnabled) {
  posthog.init(POSTHOG_KEY, {
    api_host: POSTHOG_HOST,
    // Disable in development unless explicitly enabled
    loaded: (posthog) => {
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
        console.log('PostHog initialized for development');
      }
    },
    capture_pageview: false, // We'll manually capture pageviews
    capture_pageleave: true,
    // Admin-specific configuration
    person_profiles: 'identified_only', // Only track identified admin users
  });
} else {
  console.log('PostHog not initialized - missing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY or running server-side');
}

// Safe PostHog wrapper that doesn't break when PostHog is not available
export const analytics = {
  // Track events with admin context
  track: (event: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.capture(event, {
        ...properties,
        $groups: { admin_portal: 'buzztrip_admin' },
        context: 'admin_portal'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Track (dev):', event, properties);
    }
  },

  // Identify admin users
  identify: (userId: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.identify(userId, {
        ...properties,
        role: 'admin',
        portal: 'admin'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Identify (dev):', userId, properties);
    }
  },

  // Track page views manually
  pageview: (path?: string) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.capture('$pageview', {
        $current_url: path || window.location.href,
        context: 'admin_portal'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Pageview (dev):', path || window.location.href);
    }
  },

  // Group admin users for analytics
  group: (groupType: string, groupKey: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.group(groupType, groupKey, properties);
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Group (dev):', groupType, groupKey, properties);
    }
  },

  // Reset user session
  reset: () => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.reset();
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Reset (dev)');
    }
  },

  // Check if PostHog is available
  isEnabled: () => isPostHogEnabled,

  // Get the raw PostHog instance (only when enabled)
  getInstance: () => isPostHogEnabled ? posthog : null,
};

// Admin-specific event types
export const AdminEvents = {
  // Authentication events
  ADMIN_LOGIN: 'admin_login',
  ADMIN_LOGOUT: 'admin_logout',
  ADMIN_ACCESS_DENIED: 'admin_access_denied',

  // Dashboard events
  DASHBOARD_VIEWED: 'admin_dashboard_viewed',
  METRICS_REFRESHED: 'admin_metrics_refreshed',

  // User management events
  USER_ROLE_UPDATED: 'admin_user_role_updated',
  USER_BANNED: 'admin_user_banned',
  USER_UNBANNED: 'admin_user_unbanned',
  USER_DELETED: 'admin_user_deleted',
  USER_SEARCHED: 'admin_user_searched',
  USERS_EXPORTED: 'admin_users_exported',

  // Navigation events
  PAGE_VIEWED: 'admin_page_viewed',
  FEATURE_USED: 'admin_feature_used',

  // System events
  ERROR_OCCURRED: 'admin_error_occurred',
  PERFORMANCE_MEASURED: 'admin_performance_measured',
} as const;

// Helper function to track admin actions with consistent properties
export const trackAdminAction = (
  event: string,
  properties?: Record<string, any>,
  userInfo?: { userId?: string; email?: string; role?: string }
) => {
  analytics.track(event, {
    ...properties,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    user_id: userInfo?.userId,
    user_email: userInfo?.email,
    user_role: userInfo?.role || 'admin',
    admin_portal_version: '1.0.0',
  });
};

// Helper function to track page views with admin context
export const trackAdminPageView = (page: string, additionalProperties?: Record<string, any>) => {
  analytics.track(AdminEvents.PAGE_VIEWED, {
    page,
    url: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : '',
    ...additionalProperties,
  });
};

export default analytics;
```

   196→      firstName: user.firstName,

Now let me create a React hook to handle admin user identification for better PostHog enrichment. This will automatically identify admin users when they access the portal:

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-20250514)**_

Tool use: **Write**

```typescript
"use client";

import { useUser } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { analytics } from "@/lib/posthog";

/**
 * Hook to initialize admin analytics and identify the current admin user
 */
export function useAdminAnalytics() {
  const { user } = useUser();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      // Identify the admin user in PostHog
      analytics.identify(user.id, {
        email: user.emailAddresses[0]?.emailAddress,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        role: user.publicMetadata?.role || 'admin',
        createdAt: user.createdAt,
        lastSignInAt: user.lastSignInAt,
        imageUrl: user.imageUrl,
      });

      // Set up admin group
      analytics.group('admin_portal', 'buzztrip_admin', {
        portal_type: 'admin',
        organization: 'BuzzTrip',
        environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
      });
    }
  }, [user]);

  return {
    user,
    isEnabled: analytics.isEnabled(),
    track: analytics.track,
    pageview: analytics.pageview,
    identify: analytics.identify,
    group: analytics.group,
    reset: analytics.reset,
  };
}
```

6. **Automatic User Identification** (`src/hooks/use-admin-analytics.ts`):
   - Automatically identifies admin users when they access the portal
   - Enriches user profiles with Clerk metadata
   - Sets up admin portal grouping for analytics

7. **Global Page Tracking** (`src/components/admin-layout.tsx:19-26`):
   - Tracks all page navigation within the admin portal

You have **two options** to gain admin access:

```
## Metadata in the session token

Retrieving metadata from the `User` object on the server-side requires making an API request to Clerk's Backend API, which is slower and is subject to [rate limits](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/how-clerk-works/system-limits#backend-api-requests). You can store it in the user's session token, which doesn't require making an API request as it's available on the user's authentication context. **However, there is a size limitation to keep in mind.** Clerk stores the session token in a cookie, and most browsers cap cookie size at [**4KB**⁠](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2109#section-6.3). After accounting for the size of Clerk's default claims, the cookie can support **up to 1.2KB** of custom claims. **Exceeding this limit will cause the cookie to not be set, which will break your app as Clerk depends on cookies to work properly.**

If you need to store more than 1.2KB of metadata, you should [store the extra data in your own database](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/development/webhooks/syncing#storing-extra-user-data) instead. If this isn't an option, you can [move particularly large claims out of the token](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens#example) and fetch them using a separate API call from your backend, but this approach brings back the issue of making an API request to Clerk's Backend API, which is slower and is subject to rate limits.

Another limitation of storing metadata in the session token is that when you modify metadata server-side, the changes won't appear in the session token until the next refresh. To avoid race conditions, either [force a JWT refresh](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/force-token-refresh) after metadata changes or handle the delay in your application logic.

If you've considered the limitations, and you still want to store metadata in the session token:

1.  In the Clerk Dashboard, navigate to the [**Sessions**⁠](https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=sessions) page.
2.  Under **Customize session token**, in the **Claims** editor, you can add any claim to your session token that you need and select **Save**. To avoid exceeding the session token's 1.2KB limit, it's not recommended to add the entire `user.public_metadata` object. Instead, add individual fields as claims, like `user.public_metadata.birthday`. When doing this, it's recommended to leave particularly large claims out of the token to avoid exceeding the session token's size limit. See the [example](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens#example) for more information.

## Add custom claims to your session token

[Session tokens](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens) are JWTs that are generated by Clerk on behalf of your instance, and contain claims that allow you to store data about a user's session. With Clerk, when a session token exists for a user, it indicates that the user is authenticated, and the associated claims can be retrieved at any time.

For this guide, you will use an `onboardingComplete` property in the user's public metadata to track their onboarding status. But first, you need to add a custom claim to the session token that will allow you to access the user's public metadata in your Middleware.

To edit the session token:

1.  In the Clerk Dashboard, navigate to the [**Sessions**⁠](https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=sessions) page.
    
2.  Under **Customize session token**, in the **Claims** editor, add any claim you need to your session token. For this guide, add the following:
    
    \```
    {
    "metadata":"{{user.public_metadata}}"
    }
    \```
    
3.  Select **Save**.
    
To get auto-complete and prevent TypeScript errors when working with custom session claims, you can define a global type.

1.  In your application's root folder, add a `types` directory.
2.  Inside of the `types` directory, add a `globals.d.ts` file.
3.  Create the `CustomJwtSessionClaims` interface and declare it globally.
4.  Add the custom claims to the `CustomJwtSessionClaims` interface.

For this guide, your `globals.d.ts` file should look like this:

types/globals.d.ts

\```
export {}

declare global {
interfaceCustomJwtSessionClaims {
    metadata: {
      onboardingComplete?:boolean
    }
  }
}
\```
```

   324→                          >

   328→                            <DialogTrigger asChild>

   336→                                </DialogDescription>

   340→                                <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => handleDelete(user.id)}>
   341→                                  Delete

   343→                              </DialogFooter>
   344→                            </DialogContent>
   345→                          </Dialog>
   346→                        </div>
   347→                      </TableCell>
   348→                    </TableRow>

1→import { zid } from "convex-helpers/server/zod";
     2→import * as z from "zod";
     3→import { defaultSchema, insertSchema } from "./shared-schemas";
     4→
     5→// --- Constants ---
     6→const pathTypes = ["text", "circle", "rectangle", "polygon", "line"] as const;
     7→export const pathTypeEnum = z.enum(pathTypes);
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * We are reimplementing a strict postion schema.
    11→ * A postion is a set of cordinates which can either be `[x, y]` or `[x, y, z]`
    12→ * \```ts
    13→ * type Position = [x: number, y: number] | [x: number, y: number, z: number]
    14→ * \```
    15→ */
    16→export const strictPosition = z.union([
    17→  z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()]),
    18→  z.tuple([z.number(), z.number(), z.number()]),
    19→]);
    20→
    21→// --- Measurements ---
    22→export const baseMeasurements = z.object({
    23→  perimeter: z.number(),
    24→  area: z.number().optional(),
    25→});
    26→
    27→export const circleMeasurements = baseMeasurements.extend({
    28→  radius: z.number(),
    29→  diameter: z.number(),
    30→});
    31→
    32→export const rectangleMeasurements = baseMeasurements.extend({
    33→  width: z.number(),
    34→  height: z.number(),
    35→});
    36→
    37→export const lineMeasurements = baseMeasurements;
    38→
    39→export const polygonMeasurements = baseMeasurements;
    40→
    41→export const measurementsSchema = z.union([
    42→  circleMeasurements,
    43→  rectangleMeasurements,
    44→  polygonMeasurements,
    45→  lineMeasurements,
    46→]);
    47→
    48→// --- Styles ---
    49→export const stylesSchema = z.object({
    50→  strokeColor: z.string(),
    51→  strokeOpacity: z.number().optional(),
    52→  strokeWidth: z.number().optional(),
    53→  fillColor: z.string().optional(),
    54→  fillOpacity: z.number().optional(),
    55→});
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Depending on the shape we can have different lots of points
    59→ * 1. a single point this is just a position
    60→ * 2 a line this is a position[]
    61→ * 3. a polygon this can be a position[][]
    62→ */
    63→const pointsSchema = z.union([
    64→  strictPosition,
    65→  strictPosition.array(),
    66→  strictPosition.array().array(),
    67→]);
    68→
    69→// --- Main Schema ---
    70→export const pathsSchema = defaultSchema(
    71→  z.object({
    72→    mapId: zid("maps"),
    73→    pathType: pathTypeEnum,
    74→    title: z.string(),
    75→    note: z.string().optional(),
    76→    points: pointsSchema,
    77→    measurements: measurementsSchema.optional(),
    78→    styles: stylesSchema.optional(),
    79→    createdBy: zid("users"),
    80→    updatedAt: z.string().datetime().optional(), // allow optional for updates
    81→  })
    82→);
    83→
    84→// --- Edit Schema ---
    85→export const pathsEditSchema = insertSchema(pathsSchema).extend({
    86→  createdBy: zid("users").optional(),
    87→});
    88→// Position | Position[] | Position[][]
    89→

   404→export const getGlobalStats = query({

   413→    const now = Date.now();

   429→      return hasReview && hasPhoto;

   431→
   432→    // Content quality metrics

   434→      id: review._id,

   437→      length: review.review_text?.length || 0,
   438→    }));
   439→
   440→    const photoQuality = photos.map(photo => ({
   441→      id: photo._id,

   444→    }));
   445→
   446→    // Time-based activity analysis

   451→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length,
   452→      },
   453→      lastWeek: {
   454→        placesAdded: places.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   455→        reviewsAdded: reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   456→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   457→      },
   458→      lastMonth: {
   459→        placesAdded: places.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   460→        reviewsAdded: reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   461→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   462→      },
   463→    };
   464→
   465→    // Place popularity and usage analysis
   466→    const placeUsage = places.map(place => {
   467→      const placeReviews = reviews.filter(r => r.place_id === place._id);
   468→      const placePhotos = photos.filter(p => p.place_id === place._id);
   469→      const placeMarkers = markers.filter(m => m.place_id === place._id);
   470→
   471→      return {
   472→        placeId: place._id,
   473→        reviewCount: placeReviews.length,
   474→        photoCount: placePhotos.length,
   475→        markerCount: placeMarkers.length,
   476→        averageRating: placeReviews.length > 0
   477→          ? placeReviews.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.rating || 0), 0) / placeReviews.length
   478→          : 0,
   479→        totalEngagement: placeReviews.length + placePhotos.length + placeMarkers.length,
   480→        lastActivity: Math.max(
   481→          placeReviews.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placeReviews.map(r => r._creationTime)) : 0,
   482→          placePhotos.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placePhotos.map(p => p._creationTime)) : 0,
   483→          placeMarkers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placeMarkers.map(m => m._creationTime)) : 0
   484→        ),
   485→      };
   486→    });
   487→
   488→    // Content distribution by category/type

   493→    }, {} as Record<string, number>);
   494→
   495→    // Top performing places

   505→      averageReviewLength: reviewQuality.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.length, 0) / reviewQuality.length || 0,

   508→
   509→    // Geographic and content trends

   518→

   541→        completeCoverageRate: Math.round((placesWithBoth / totalPlaces) * 100) || 0,
   542→      },
   543→
   544→      // Activity metrics

   295→    const mapsWithMarkers = maps.filter(map =>
   296→      markers.some(marker => marker.map_id === map._id)
   297→    ).length;
   298→
   299→    const mapsWithCollections = maps.filter(map =>
   300→      collections.some(collection => collection.map_id === map._id)
   301→    ).length;
   302→
   303→    const mapsWithPaths = maps.filter(map =>
   304→      paths.some(path => path.mapId === map._id)
   305→    ).length;
   306→
   307→    const mapsWithCollaborators = new Set(mapUsers.map(mu => mu.map_id)).size;
   308→
   309→    // User engagement patterns
   310→    const userActivity = users.map(user => {
   311→      const userMaps = maps.filter(m => m.owner_id === user._id);
   312→      const userMarkers = markers.filter(m => userMaps.some(map => map._id === m.map_id));
   313→      const userCollaborations = mapUsers.filter(mu => mu.user_id === user._id);
   314→
   315→      return {
   316→        userId: user._id,
   317→        mapsCreated: userMaps.length,
   318→        markersCreated: userMarkers.length,
   319→        collaborations: userCollaborations.length,
   320→        totalActivity: userMaps.length + userMarkers.length + userCollaborations.length,
   321→        lastActive: Math.max(
   322→          userMaps.length > 0 ? Math.max(...userMaps.map(m => m._creationTime)) : 0,
   323→          userMarkers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...userMarkers.map(m => m._creationTime)) : 0
   324→        ),
   325→      };
   326→    });
   327→
   328→    // Engagement segmentation
   329→    const activeUsers = userActivity.filter(u => u.lastActive > oneMonthAgo).length;
   330→    const powerUsers = userActivity.filter(u => u.totalActivity >= 10).length;
   331→    const collaborativeUsers = userActivity.filter(u => u.collaborations > 0).length;
   332→
   333→    // Content creation trends (hourly patterns)
   334→    const creationByHour = new Array(24).fill(0);
   335→    const allContent = [...maps, ...markers, ...collections, ...paths];
   336→    allContent.forEach(item => {
   337→      const hour = new Date(item._creationTime).getUTCHours();
   338→      creationByHour[hour]++;
   339→    });
   340→
   341→    // Weekly activity distribution
   342→    const activityByDay = new Array(7).fill(0);
   343→    allContent.forEach(item => {
   344→      const day = new Date(item._creationTime).getUTCDay();
   345→      activityByDay[day]++;
   346→    });
   347→
   348→    // Feature usage statistics
   349→    const featureUsage = {
   350→      markerAdoption: Math.round((mapsWithMarkers / maps.length) * 100) || 0,
   351→      collectionAdoption: Math.round((mapsWithCollections / maps.length) * 100) || 0,
   352→      pathAdoption: Math.round((mapsWithPaths / maps.length) * 100) || 0,
   353→      collaborationAdoption: Math.round((mapsWithCollaborators / maps.length) * 100) || 0,
   354→    };
   355→
   356→    // Engagement quality metrics
   357→    const engagementMetrics = {
   358→      activeUserRate: Math.round((activeUsers / users.length) * 100) || 0,
   359→      powerUserRate: Math.round((powerUsers / users.length) * 100) || 0,
   360→      collaborationRate: Math.round((collaborativeUsers / users.length) * 100) || 0,
   361→      averageActivityPerUser: Math.round((userActivity.reduce((sum, u) => sum + u.totalActivity, 0) / users.length) * 100) / 100,
   362→    };
   363→
   364→    return {
   365→      // Time-based activity
   366→      activity,
   367→
   368→      // Feature adoption
   369→      featureUsage,
   370→      mapsWithContent: {
   371→        withMarkers: mapsWithMarkers,
   372→        withCollections: mapsWithCollections,
   373→        withPaths: mapsWithPaths,
   374→        withCollaborators: mapsWithCollaborators,
   375→      },
   376→
   377→      // User engagement
   378→      engagementMetrics,
   379→      userSegmentation: {
   380→        totalUsers: users.length,
   381→        activeUsers,
   382→        powerUsers,
   383→        collaborativeUsers,
   384→      },
   385→
   386→      // Temporal patterns
   387→      creationByHour,
   388→      activityByDay,
   389→      peakActivity: {
   390→        hour: creationByHour.indexOf(Math.max(...creationByHour)),
   391→        day: activityByDay.indexOf(Math.max(...activityByDay)),
   392→      },
   393→
   394→      // Growth indicators
   395→      isEngagementIncreasing: activity.lastWeek.mapsCreated > activity.lastMonth.mapsCreated / 4,
   396→      contentVelocity: Math.round(((activity.lastWeek.markersCreated + activity.lastWeek.collectionsCreated + activity.lastWeek.pathsCreated) / 7) * 100) / 100,
   397→    };

   401→/**
   402→ * Enhanced admin query to get comprehensive global content statistics
   403→ */
   404→export const getGlobalStats = query({
   405→  args: {},
   406→  handler: async (ctx) => {
   407→    // Get all global data
   408→    const places = await ctx.db.query("places").collect();
   409→    const reviews = await ctx.db.query("places_reviews").collect();
   410→    const photos = await ctx.db.query("place_photos").collect();
   411→    const markers = await ctx.db.query("markers").collect();
   412→
   413→    const now = Date.now();
   414→    const oneDayAgo = now - (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
   415→    const oneWeekAgo = now - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
   416→    const oneMonthAgo = now - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
   417→
   418→    // Basic statistics
   419→    const totalPlaces = places.length;
   420→    const totalReviews = reviews.length;
   421→    const totalPhotos = photos.length;
   422→
   423→    // Content coverage analysis
   424→    const placesWithReviews = new Set(reviews.map(review => review.place_id)).size;
   425→    const placesWithPhotos = new Set(photos.map(photo => photo.place_id)).size;
   426→    const placesWithBoth = places.filter(place => {
   427→      const hasReview = reviews.some(r => r.place_id === place._id);
   428→      const hasPhoto = photos.some(p => p.place_id === place._id);
   429→      return hasReview && hasPhoto;
   430→    }).length;
   431→
   432→    // Content quality metrics
   433→    const reviewQuality = reviews.map(review => ({
   434→      id: review._id,
   435→      rating: review.rating || 0,
   436→      hasText: !!(review.description && review.description.length > 10),
   437→      length: review.description?.length || 0,
   438→    }));
   439→
   440→    const photoQuality = photos.map(photo => ({
   441→      id: photo._id,
   442→      hasCaption: !!(photo.caption && photo.caption.length > 0),
   443→      hasMetadata: false, // No metadata field exists in schema
   444→    }));
   445→
   446→    // Time-based activity analysis
   447→    const activity = {
   448→      last24h: {
   449→        placesAdded: places.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length,
   450→        reviewsAdded: reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length,
   451→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length,
   452→      },
   453→      lastWeek: {
   454→        placesAdded: places.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   455→        reviewsAdded: reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   456→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length,
   457→      },
   458→      lastMonth: {
   459→        placesAdded: places.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   460→        reviewsAdded: reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   461→        photosAdded: photos.filter(p => p._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length,
   462→      },
   463→    };
   464→
   465→    // Place popularity and usage analysis
   466→    const placeUsage = places.map(place => {
   467→      const placeReviews = reviews.filter(r => r.place_id === place._id);
   468→      const placePhotos = photos.filter(p => p.place_id === place._id);
   469→      const placeMarkers = markers.filter(m => m.place_id === place._id);
   470→
   471→      return {
   472→        placeId: place._id,
   473→        reviewCount: placeReviews.length,
   474→        photoCount: placePhotos.length,
   475→        markerCount: placeMarkers.length,
   476→        averageRating: placeReviews.length > 0
   477→          ? placeReviews.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.rating || 0), 0) / placeReviews.length
   478→          : 0,
   479→        totalEngagement: placeReviews.length + placePhotos.length + placeMarkers.length,
   480→        lastActivity: Math.max(
   481→          placeReviews.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placeReviews.map(r => r._creationTime)) : 0,
   482→          placePhotos.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placePhotos.map(p => p._creationTime)) : 0,
   483→          placeMarkers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...placeMarkers.map(m => m._creationTime)) : 0
   484→        ),
   485→      };
   486→    });
   487→
   488→    // Content distribution by category/type
   489→    const placeCategories = places.reduce((acc, place) => {
   490→      const category = place.category || 'uncategorized';
   491→      acc[category] = (acc[category] || 0) + 1;
   492→      return acc;
   493→    }, {} as Record<string, number>);
   494→
   495→    // Top performing places
   496→    const topPlaces = placeUsage
   497→      .sort((a, b) => b.totalEngagement - a.totalEngagement)
   498→      .slice(0, 10);
   499→
   500→    // Quality metrics
   501→    const qualityMetrics = {
   502→      reviewsWithText: reviewQuality.filter(r => r.hasText).length,
   503→      reviewsWithRating: reviewQuality.filter(r => r.rating > 0).length,
   504→      photosWithCaptions: photoQuality.filter(p => p.hasCaption).length,
   505→      averageReviewLength: reviewQuality.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.length, 0) / reviewQuality.length || 0,
   506→      averageRating: reviewQuality.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rating, 0) / reviewQuality.length || 0,
   507→    };
   508→
   509→    // Geographic and content trends
   510→    const contentTrends = [];
   511→    for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
   512→      const dayStart = now - (i * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
   513→      const dayEnd = dayStart + (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
   514→
   515→      const dayPlaces = places.filter(p => p._creationTime >= dayStart && p._creationTime < dayEnd);
   516→      const dayReviews = reviews.filter(r => r._creationTime >= dayStart && r._creationTime < dayEnd);
   517→      const dayPhotos = photos.filter(p => p._creationTime >= dayStart && p._creationTime < dayEnd);
   518→
   519→      contentTrends.push({
   520→        date: new Date(dayStart).toISOString().split('T')[0],
   521→        places: dayPlaces.length,
   522→        reviews: dayReviews.length,
   523→        photos: dayPhotos.length,
   524→        totalContent: dayPlaces.length + dayReviews.length + dayPhotos.length,
   525→      });
   526→    }
   527→
   528→    return {
   529→      // Core metrics
   530→      totalPlaces,
   531→      totalReviews,
   532→      totalPhotos,
   533→
   534→      // Coverage analysis
   535→      contentCoverage: {
   536→        placesWithReviews,
   537→        placesWithPhotos,
   538→        placesWithBoth,
   539→        reviewCoverageRate: Math.round((placesWithReviews / totalPlaces) * 100) || 0,
   540→        photoCoverageRate: Math.round((placesWithPhotos / totalPlaces) * 100) || 0,
   541→        completeCoverageRate: Math.round((placesWithBoth / totalPlaces) * 100) || 0,
   542→      },
   543→
   544→      // Activity metrics
   545→      activity,
   546→
   547→      // Quality metrics
   548→      quality: {
   549→        ...qualityMetrics,
   550→        averageReviewsPerPlace: Math.round((totalReviews / totalPlaces) * 100) / 100 || 0,
   551→        averagePhotosPerPlace: Math.round((totalPhotos / totalPlaces) * 100) / 100 || 0,
   552→        reviewQualityScore: Math.round((qualityMetrics.reviewsWithText / totalReviews) * 100) || 0,
   553→        photoQualityScore: Math.round((qualityMetrics.photosWithCaptions / totalPhotos) * 100) || 0,
   554→      },
   555→
   556→      // Distribution and popularity
   557→      placeCategories,
   558→      topPlaces,
   559→
   560→      // Trends
   561→      contentTrends,
   562→
   563→      // Growth indicators
   564→      contentGrowthRate: Math.round((activity.lastMonth.placesAdded / Math.max(totalPlaces - activity.lastMonth.placesAdded, 1)) * 100 * 100) / 100,
   565→      isContentGrowthAccelerating: activity.lastWeek.placesAdded > activity.lastMonth.placesAdded / 4,
   566→      contentVelocity: Math.round(((activity.lastWeek.reviewsAdded + activity.lastWeek.photosAdded) / 7) * 100) / 100,
   567→    };
   568→  },
   569→});

TITLE: Define Custom Sort Function for Fuzzy Filtered Data in TanStack Table
DESCRIPTION: This TypeScript function defines a custom sorting logic that prioritizes the rank information provided by `@tanstack/match-sorter-utils` for fuzzy filtered items. It falls back to alphanumeric sorting if the item ranks are equal, ensuring consistent sorting behavior.

SOURCE: https://github.com/tanstack/table/blob/main/docs/guide/fuzzy-filtering.md#_snippet_3

LANGUAGE: typescript
CODE:
\```
import { compareItems } from '@tanstack/match-sorter-utils'
import { sortingFns } from '@tanstack/table'

const fuzzySort: SortingFn<any> = (rowA, rowB, columnId) => {
  let dir = 0

  // Only sort by rank if the column has ranking information
  if (rowA.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]) {
    dir = compareItems(
      rowA.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]?.itemRank!,
      rowB.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]?.itemRank!
    )
  }

  // Provide an alphanumeric fallback for when the item ranks are equal
  return dir === 0 ? sortingFns.alphanumeric(rowA, rowB, columnId) : dir
}
\```

TITLE: Controlling Specific TanStack Table States with External State Management
DESCRIPTION: This snippet demonstrates how to manage specific table states (e.g., column filters, sorting, pagination) externally using React's `useState` hook. It shows how to pass these controlled states back to the table via the `state` option and hoist state changes using `on[State]Change` callbacks, which is particularly useful for server-side data fetching scenarios.

SOURCE: https://github.com/tanstack/table/blob/main/docs/framework/react/guide/table-state.md#_snippet_2

LANGUAGE: jsx
CODE:
\```
const [columnFilters, setColumnFilters] = React.useState([]) //no default filters
const [sorting, setSorting] = React.useState([
  {
    id: 'age',
    desc: true, //sort by age in descending order by default
  }
]) 
const [pagination, setPagination] = React.useState({ pageIndex: 0, pageSize: 15 })

//Use our controlled state values to fetch data
const tableQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['users', columnFilters, sorting, pagination],
  queryFn: () => fetchUsers(columnFilters, sorting, pagination),
  //...
})

const table = useReactTable({
  columns,
  data: tableQuery.data,
  //...
  state: {
    columnFilters, //pass controlled state back to the table (overrides internal state)
    sorting,
    pagination
  },
  onColumnFiltersChange: setColumnFilters, //hoist columnFilters state into our own state management
  onSortingChange: setSorting,
  onPaginationChange: setPagination,
})
\```

--------------------------------

TITLE: Custom Fuzzy Filter and Sort Functions for TanStack Table
DESCRIPTION: This example demonstrates how to implement custom `fuzzyFilter` and `fuzzySort` functions using `@tanstack/match-sorter-utils`. The `fuzzyFilter` ranks items and stores ranking information as `filter meta` using `addMeta`, while `fuzzySort` utilizes this meta-information for sorting, falling back to alphanumeric sort if no ranking is available.

SOURCE: https://github.com/tanstack/table/blob/main/docs/api/features/column-filtering.md#_snippet_4

LANGUAGE: tsx
CODE:
\```
import { sortingFns } from '@tanstack/react-table'

import { rankItem, compareItems } from '@tanstack/match-sorter-utils'

const fuzzyFilter = (row, columnId, value, addMeta) => {
  // Rank the item
  const itemRank = rankItem(row.getValue(columnId), value)

  // Store the ranking info
  addMeta(itemRank)

  // Return if the item should be filtered in/out
  return itemRank.passed
}

const fuzzySort = (rowA, rowB, columnId) => {
  let dir = 0

  // Only sort by rank if the column has ranking information
  if (rowA.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]) {
    dir = compareItems(
      rowA.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]!,
      rowB.columnFiltersMeta[columnId]!
    )
  }

  // Provide an alphanumeric fallback for when the item ranks are equal
  return dir === 0 ? sortingFns.alphanumeric(rowA, rowB, columnId) : dir
}
\```

--------------------------------

TITLE: Controlling Specific TanStack Table States (Filtering, Sorting, Pagination)
DESCRIPTION: This snippet demonstrates how to individually control specific table states such as column filters, sorting, and pagination in TanStack Table. It shows how to store these states using Vue's `ref` and pass them to the table instance along with their respective `on[State]Change` callbacks. The example also integrates with `useQuery` for server-side data fetching based on these controlled states.

SOURCE: https://github.com/tanstack/table/blob/main/docs/framework/vue/guide/table-state.md#_snippet_4

LANGUAGE: ts
CODE:
\```
const columnFilters = ref([]) //no default filters
const sorting = ref([
  {
    id: 'age',
    desc: true, //sort by age in descending order by default
  }
])
const pagination = ref({ pageIndex: 0, pageSize: 15 }

//Use our controlled state values to fetch data
const tableQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['users', columnFilters, sorting, pagination],
  queryFn: () => fetchUsers(columnFilters, sorting, pagination),
  //...
})

const table = useVueTable({
  columns,
  data: tableQuery.data,
  //...
  state: {
    get columnFilters() {
      return columnFilters.value
    },
    get sorting() {
      return sorting.value
    },
    get pagination() {
      return pagination.value
    }
  },
  onColumnFiltersChange: updater => {
    columnFilters.value =
      updater instanceof Function
        ? updater(columnFilters.value)
        : updater
  },
  onSortingChange: updater => {
    sorting.value =
      updater instanceof Function
        ? updater(sorting.value)
        : updater
  },
  onPaginationChange: updater => {
    pagination.value =
      updater instanceof Function
        ? updater(pagination.value)
        : updater
  },
})
\```

--------------------------------

    33→export default function UsersPage() {

    40→  const [hasPreviousPage, setHasPreviousPage] = useState(false);
    41→  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<any>(null);
    42→  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error', text: string } | null>(null);
    43→
    44→  const pageSize = 10;
    45→
    46→  const loadUsers = async (page: number = 1) => {
    47→    try {
    48→      setLoading(true);
    49→      const result = await getUsers(page, pageSize);
    50→      setUsers(result.users);
    51→      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
    52→      setHasNextPage(result.hasNextPage);
    53→      setHasPreviousPage(result.hasPreviousPage);
    54→      setCurrentPage(page);
    55→    } catch (error) {
    56→      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to load users' });
    57→    } finally {
    58→      setLoading(false);
    59→    }
    60→  };
    61→
    62→  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    63→    try {
    64→      const stats = await getUserStatistics();
    65→      setStatistics(stats);
    66→    } catch (error) {
    67→      console.error('Failed to load statistics:', error);
    68→    }
    69→  };
    70→
    71→  const handleSearch = async () => {
    72→    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
    73→      loadUsers(1);
    74→      return;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    try {
    78→      setLoading(true);
    79→      const result = await searchUsers(searchQuery, pageSize);
    80→      setUsers(result.users);
    81→      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
    82→      setHasNextPage(false);
    83→      setHasPreviousPage(false);
    84→      setCurrentPage(1);
    85→    } catch (error) {
    86→      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to search users' });
    87→    } finally {
    88→      setLoading(false);
    89→    }
    90→  };
    91→
    92→  const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, newRole: Roles) => {
    93→    try {
    94→      const result = await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);
    95→      if (result.success) {
    96→        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
    97→        // Update the user in the local state
    98→        setUsers(users.map(user =>
    99→          user.id === userId ? { ...user, role: newRole } : user
   100→        ));
   101→        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
   102→      } else {
   103→        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
   104→      }
   105→    } catch (error) {
   106→      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user role' });
   107→    }
   108→  };
   109→
   110→  const handleBanToggle = async (userId: string, currentBanned: boolean) => {
   111→    try {
   112→      const result = await toggleUserBan(userId, !currentBanned);
   113→      if (result.success) {
   114→        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
   115→        // Update the user in the local state
   116→        setUsers(users.map(user =>
   117→          user.id === userId ? { ...user, banned: !currentBanned } : user
   118→        ));
   119→        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
   120→      } else {
   121→        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
   122→      }
   123→    } catch (error) {
   124→      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user status' });
   125→    }
   126→  };
   127→
   128→  const handleDelete = async (userId: string) => {
   129→    try {
   130→      const result = await deleteUser(userId);
   131→      if (result.success) {
   132→        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
   133→        // Remove the user from local state
   134→        setUsers(users.filter(user => user.id !== userId));
   135→        setTotalCount(totalCount - 1);
   136→        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
   137→      } else {
   138→        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
   139→      }
   140→    } catch (error) {
   141→      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to delete user' });
   142→    }
   143→  };
   144→
   145→  useEffect(() => {

   176→  return (

   199→            </CardContent>

   207→            </CardContent>
   208→          </Card>

I've successfully tested the TanStack Table implementation with Playwright and confirmed that all features are working perfectly:

   - Resets all filters and search terms

8. **⚡ Real-time Data**:
   - Connected to actual Clerk user data
   - Shows real user information and statistics
   - Interactive role management dropdowns

### 🏗️ **Technical Implementation Highlights:**

- **TanStack Table v8** with full TypeScript support
- **Advanced filtering** with global and column-specific filters
- **Client-side sorting** with visual indicators
- **Flexible pagination** with customizable page sizes
- **useCallback optimization** for performance
- **Proper error handling** and loading states

     export const checkRole = async (role: Roles): Promise<boolean> => {

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@buzztrip/components";
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Alert,
  AlertDescription,
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  Separator,
} from "@buzztrip/components/ui";
import { ArrowLeft, Shield, Ban, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { type AdminUser, updateUserRole, toggleUserBan, deleteUser } from "@/app/actions/user-management";
import { useUserStats, useMapStats } from "@/hooks/use-admin-data";
import { Roles } from "@/types/globals";

export default function UserProfilePage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const userId = params.id as string;

  const [user, setUser] = useState<AdminUser | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error', text: string } | null>(null);

  const userStats = useUserStats();
  const mapStats = useMapStats();

  useEffect(() => {
    // In a real app, you'd fetch the individual user data here
    // For now, we'll simulate with the user stats data
    const loadUserProfile = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        // Simulate API call delay
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

        // Mock user data - in real app would fetch from Clerk/Convex
        const mockUser: AdminUser = {
          id: userId,
          email: "user@example.com",
          firstName: "Sample",
          lastName: "User",
          imageUrl: "https://images.clerk.dev/uploaded/img_placeholder.svg",
          createdAt: Date.now() - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 30 days ago
          lastSignInAt: Date.now() - (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 1 day ago
          role: "user" as Roles,
          banned: false,
        };

        setUser(mockUser);
      } catch (error) {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to load user profile' });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadUserProfile();
  }, [userId]);

  const handleRoleUpdate = async (newRole: Roles) => {
    if (!user) return;

    setUpdating(true);
    try {
      const result = await updateUserRole(user.id, newRole);
      if (result.success) {
        setUser({ ...user, role: newRole });
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user role' });
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBanToggle = async () => {
    if (!user) return;

    setUpdating(true);
    try {
      const result = await toggleUserBan(user.id, !user.banned);
      if (result.success) {
        setUser({ ...user, banned: !user.banned });
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user status' });
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!user || !confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this user? This action cannot be undone.')) return;

    setUpdating(true);
    try {
      const result = await deleteUser(user.id);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        setTimeout(() => router.push('/users'), 2000);
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to delete user' });
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto-hide messages after 5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (message) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage(null), 5000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message]);

  const formatDate = (timestamp: number) => {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => router.back()}>
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Loading User Profile...</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => (
            <Card key={i}>
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="h-5 bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse" />
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="h-8 bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse" />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!user) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => router.back()}>
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">User Not Found</h1>
        </div>
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>
            The requested user profile could not be found.
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => router.back()}>
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img
              src={user.imageUrl}
              alt={`${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`}
              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full"
            />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">{user.firstName} {user.lastName}</h1>
              <p className="text-slate-600">{user.email}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Badge variant={user.banned ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'}>
          {user.banned ? 'Banned' : 'Active'}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      {/* Message Alert */}
      {message && (
        <Alert variant={message.type === 'error' ? 'destructive' : 'default'}>
          <AlertDescription>{message.text}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* User Details */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Account Information</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">User ID</label>
              <p className="text-sm font-mono bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded">{user.id}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">Created</label>
              <p>{formatDate(user.createdAt)}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">Last Sign In</label>
              <p>{user.lastSignInAt ? formatDate(user.lastSignInAt) : 'Never'}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">Current Role</label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                <Badge variant={user.role === 'admin' ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'}>
                  {user.role || 'User'}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Activity Statistics</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">Maps Created</span>
              <Badge variant="outline">2</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">Markers Added</span>
              <Badge variant="outline">15</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">Collections</span>
              <Badge variant="outline">3</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">Collaborations</span>
              <Badge variant="outline">1</Badge>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Admin Actions</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 mb-2 block">
                Update Role
              </label>
              <Select
                value={user.role || 'user'}
                onValueChange={(value) => handleRoleUpdate(value as Roles)}
                disabled={updating}
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="user">User</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <Separator />

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={handleBanToggle}
                disabled={updating}
                className="w-full"
              >
                <Ban className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {user.banned ? 'Unban User' : 'Ban User'}
              </Button>

              <Button
                variant="destructive"
                onClick={handleDelete}
                disabled={updating}
                className="w-full"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Delete User
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Recent Activity */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Recent Activity</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Mock activity data */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-green-500 rounded-full"></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium">Created map "Downtown Food Tour"</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">2 days ago</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Badge variant="outline">Map</Badge>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full"></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium">Added 5 markers to "Coffee Shops"</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">5 days ago</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Badge variant="outline">Markers</Badge>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-purple-500 rounded-full"></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium">Created collection "Best Restaurants"</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">1 week ago</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Badge variant="outline">Collection</Badge>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

export const getMapStats = query({
  args: {},
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    // Get all data
    const allMaps = await ctx.db.query("maps").collect();
    const mapUsers = await ctx.db.query("map_users").collect();
    const markers = await ctx.db.query("markers").collect();
    const collections = await ctx.db.query("collections").collect();
    const paths = await ctx.db.query("paths").collect();

    const now = Date.now();
    const oneDayAgo = now - (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const oneWeekAgo = now - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const oneMonthAgo = now - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    // Basic map statistics
    const totalMaps = allMaps.length;
    const publicMaps = allMaps.filter(map => map.visibility === "public").length;
    const privateMaps = allMaps.filter(map => map.visibility === "private").length;
    const sharedMaps = allMaps.filter(map => map.visibility === "unlisted").length;

    // Activity patterns by time period
    const mapsLast24h = allMaps.filter(map => map._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length;
    const mapsLastWeek = allMaps.filter(map => map._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length;
    const mapsLastMonth = allMaps.filter(map => map._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length;

    // Map complexity analysis
    const mapComplexity = allMaps.map(map => {
      const mapMarkers = markers.filter(m => m.map_id === map._id);
      const mapCollections = collections.filter(c => c.map_id === map._id);
      const mapPaths = paths.filter(p => p.mapId === map._id);
      const mapCollaborators = mapUsers.filter(mu => mu.map_id === map._id);

      return {
        mapId: map._id,
        markerCount: mapMarkers.length,
        collectionCount: mapCollections.length,
        pathCount: mapPaths.length,
        collaboratorCount: mapCollaborators.length,
        totalElements: mapMarkers.length + mapCollections.length + mapPaths.length,
        complexity: mapMarkers.length * 1 + mapCollections.length * 2 + mapPaths.length * 3, // weighted complexity
        visibility: map.visibility,
        createdAt: map._creationTime,
      };
    });

    // Complexity metrics
    const complexityStats = {
      simple: mapComplexity.filter(m => m.complexity <= 5).length,
      moderate: mapComplexity.filter(m => m.complexity > 5 && m.complexity <= 20).length,
      complex: mapComplexity.filter(m => m.complexity > 20 && m.complexity <= 50).length,

     export const getDetailedMaps = query({
       args: {},

         const allUsers = await ctx.db.query("users").collect();
         const mapUsers = await ctx.db.query("map_users").collect();
         const markers = await ctx.db.query("markers").collect();
         const collections = await ctx.db.query("collections").collect();
         
         const userLookup = new Map();
         allUsers.forEach(user => {

             id: user._id,
             name: `${user.firstName || ''} ${user.lastName || ''}`.trim() || 'Unknown User',
             email: user.email || 'No email',
           });
         });
         
         const detailedMaps = allMaps.map(map => {
           const mapCollaborators = mapUsers.filter(mu => mu.map_id === map._id);
           const mapMarkers = markers.filter(m => m.map_id === map._id);
           const mapCollections = collections.filter(c => c.map_id === map._id);
           const creator = userLookup.get(map.owner_id) || {
             id: map.owner_id,
             name: 'Unknown User',
             email: 'No email'
           };

             id: map._id,
             title: map.title || 'Untitled Map',

             markerCount: mapMarkers.length,
             collaboratorCount: mapCollaborators.length,
             isPublic: map.visibility === 'public',

             createdAt: map._creationTime,
             lastModified: map._creationTime,
             status: 'active',
             description: map.description || '',
           };
         });
         
         return detailedMaps.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
       },
     });

     7→export const getUserStats = query({
     8→  args: {},
     9→  handler: async (ctx) => {
    10→    // Get all users for comprehensive analysis
    11→    const allUsers = await ctx.db.query("users").collect();
    12→    const now = Date.now();
    13→
    14→    // Define time periods
    15→    const oneDayAgo = now - (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    16→    const oneWeekAgo = now - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    17→    const oneMonthAgo = now - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    18→    const threeMonthsAgo = now - (90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    19→    const oneYearAgo = now - (365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    20→
    21→    // Basic counts
    22→    const totalUsers = allUsers.length;
    23→    const usersLast24h = allUsers.filter(u => u._creationTime > oneDayAgo).length;
    24→    const usersLastWeek = allUsers.filter(u => u._creationTime > oneWeekAgo).length;
    25→    const usersLastMonth = allUsers.filter(u => u._creationTime > oneMonthAgo).length;
    26→    const usersLast3Months = allUsers.filter(u => u._creationTime > threeMonthsAgo).length;
    27→
    28→    // Growth rate calculations
    29→    const dailyGrowthRate = usersLast24h;
    30→    const weeklyGrowthRate = usersLastWeek;
    31→    const monthlyGrowthRate = ((usersLastMonth / Math.max(totalUsers - usersLastMonth, 1)) * 100);
    32→
    33→    // Registration trends (last 30 days)
    34→    const registrationTrends = [];
    35→    for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    36→      const dayStart = now - (i * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    37→      const dayEnd = dayStart + (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    38→      const dayUsers = allUsers.filter(user =>
    39→        user._creationTime >= dayStart && user._creationTime < dayEnd
    40→      );
    41→      registrationTrends.push({
    42→        date: new Date(dayStart).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    43→        count: dayUsers.length,
    44→        dayOfWeek: new Date(dayStart).getDay(),
    45→        weekNumber: Math.floor(i / 7)
    46→      });
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    // Weekly aggregation for cleaner trends
    50→    const weeklyTrends = [];
    51→    for (let week = 0; week < 12; week++) {
    52→      const weekStart = now - ((week + 1) * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    53→      const weekEnd = now - (week * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    54→      const weekUsers = allUsers.filter(user =>
    55→        user._creationTime >= weekStart && user._creationTime < weekEnd
    56→      );
    57→      weeklyTrends.unshift({
    58→        week: `Week ${12 - week}`,
    59→        count: weekUsers.length,
    60→        startDate: new Date(weekStart).toISOString().split('T')[0]
    61→      });
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    // User engagement patterns
    65→    const usersByHour = new Array(24).fill(0);
    66→    const usersByDayOfWeek = new Array(7).fill(0);
    67→
    68→    allUsers.forEach(user => {
    69→      const createdDate = new Date(user._creationTime);
    70→      usersByHour[createdDate.getUTCHours()]++;
    71→      usersByDayOfWeek[createdDate.getUTCDay()]++;
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    // Retention analysis (users who created maps)
    75→    const maps = await ctx.db.query("maps").collect();
    76→    const usersWithMaps = new Set(maps.map(m => m.owner_id));
    77→    const retentionRate = (usersWithMaps.size / totalUsers) * 100;
    78→
    79→    return {
    80→      // Core metrics
    81→      totalUsers,
    82→      usersLast24h,
    83→      usersLastWeek,
    84→      usersLastMonth,
    85→      usersLast3Months,
    86→
    87→      // Growth metrics
    88→      dailyGrowthRate,
    89→      weeklyGrowthRate,
    90→      monthlyGrowthRate: Math.round(monthlyGrowthRate * 100) / 100,
    91→      averageUsersPerDay: Math.round((usersLastMonth / 30) * 100) / 100,
    92→
    93→      // Trends
    94→      registrationTrends,
    95→      weeklyTrends,
    96→
    97→      // Engagement patterns
    98→      usersByHour,

   100→      retentionRate: Math.round(retentionRate * 100) / 100,
